Many builders now reuse bricks and timber from older buildings that are pulled down. (現在許多建商會重複利用拆除老建築後的磚塊和木材。)

meaning: adj. 不活躍的；不活動的
example: Office workers who remain inactive for hours should take short walks to protect their health. (長時間不活動的上班族應該起身走動，以保護健康。)

The school auditorium was too small for the annual concert, so the event moved to the town hall. (學校禮堂容不下年度音樂會，因此活動改到市政廳舉行。)
The discovery of penicillin was an accident that has saved millions of lives. (盤尼西林是偶然發現的，此後救了數百萬人的性命。)
The volcano has been dormant for two hundred years but is still watched. (這座火山已休眠兩百年，但仍受到監測。)
A hasty decision to sell the land cost the family a fortune. (匆忙決定賣地讓這家人損失了一大筆錢。)
Local engineers showed great ingenuity in rebuilding the bridge with limited materials. (當地工程師在材料有限的情況下重建橋樑，展現了極大的獨創性。)

meaning:

example: Road works forced us to take a long detour through the hills. (道路施工迫使我們繞道，穿過山區走了一大段遠路。)

Daily conversation with native speakers improved her fluency within a few months. (每天與母語人士交談，讓她的流利度在幾個月內提升。)
A stone broke one pane of the classroom window during the storm. (暴風雨期間，一顆石頭打破了教室窗戶的一塊玻璃。)
This coating repels water, so the jacket stays dry in light rain. (這層塗料能排斥水，因此這件外套在小雨中仍保持乾燥。)
The family returned to its small ancestral village for the spring festival. (這家人回到祖居的小村落過春節。)
Fishing boats shelter in a small inlet whenever the weather turns rough. (天氣轉壞時，漁船就停泊在一處小水灣避風。)
A sudden gust of wind blew the door open and scattered the papers. (突然一陣狂風吹開門，把紙張吹得四散。)
She applied lotion to her hands after washing them in the cold water. (她用冷水洗完手後，抹上潤膚乳。)
The young racehorse has an impressive pedigree and attracted several wealthy buyers. (這匹年輕賽馬血統優良，吸引了幾位富有買家。)
The umpire stopped the tennis match when the rain became far too heavy to play in. (雨勢大到無法比賽時，裁判中止了這場網球賽。)
Some forms of cancer are hereditary, so families may be offered regular screening. (有些癌症是遺傳的，因此家族成員可能獲得定期篩檢。)
Sharp rocks protrude from the shallow water, so swimmers should enter the bay cautiously. (尖銳的岩石突出於淺水中，因此泳客應小心進入海灣。)
The little café has a loyal clientele of nearby office and shop workers. (這家小咖啡館有一群忠實顧客，是附近的上班族和店員。)
Small family farms predominate in the valley, while large estates cover the plain. (山谷裡以小型家庭農場為主，平原上則是大片莊園。)

meaning:
n. 雪崩；崩落
v. 雪崩般湧來；蜂擁
example: An avalanche blocked the only road to the ski village for three days. (一場雪崩使通往滑雪村的唯一道路中斷三天。)
A thorn pierced his glove as he cut back the overgrown hedge. (他修剪過長的樹籬時，一根刺刺穿了他的手套。)
Externally, the building looks plain, but its interior is full of light and colour. (這棟建築外觀看來樸素，內部卻充滿光線與色彩。)
Old plastic pipes become brittle and may crack during very cold weather. (老舊塑膠管會變脆，在天氣很冷時可能裂開。)

The final paragraph encapsulates the whole argument in just two clear sentences. (最後一段只用兩句清楚的話總結整個論點。)
He took notes in shorthand and typed them up after the meeting. (他用速記做筆記，會後再打成文字。)
Clean air is becoming a rarity in rapidly industrialising cities across the region. (在該地區快速工業化的城市裡，乾淨空氣正變得稀有。)
The pain in his abdomen became worse, so he went to the hospital that evening. (他腹部疼痛加劇，所以當晚去了醫院。)
The two families called a truce so that the wedding could go ahead. (兩家人暫時休戰，好讓婚禮順利舉行。)
The writer chose to seclude herself in a small cottage in order to finish her novel. (那位作家選擇把自己隔離在一間小屋裡，以完成小說。)
The dispersal of seeds by migratory birds helps forests recover after logging. (候鳥散佈種子，幫助森林在伐木後復原。)
The doctor advised him to avoid strenuous exercise for at least six weeks. (醫師建議他至少六週內避免劇烈運動。)

meaning:
v. 喪失；沒收
n. 喪失；沒收物
example: Tenants who ignore repeated warnings about late-night noise may forfeit the right to renew their lease next year. (忽視深夜噪音多次警告的房客，可能會喪失明年續租的權利。)
The school installed a hive on the roof, and pupils now quietly study bees without leaving the building. (學校在屋頂設置蜂箱，學生現在不必離開校舍就能安靜觀察蜜蜂。)
The report was based on erroneous data collected during the previous winter. (這份報告根據的是前一年冬天蒐集的錯誤資料。)
Her mother sewed the frock by hand, adding small delicate pearls that had belonged to her own grandmother. (她母親親手縫製這件連衣裙，還加上原本屬於她祖母的小巧精緻珍珠。)
The kitchen has stainless steel surfaces that are very easy to clean. (廚房用不鏽鋼檯面，很容易清理。)

meaning:
n. 美食家；老饕
adj. 美食的；精緻的
example: My uncle is a gourmet who travels long distances just to try new dishes. (我叔叔是美食家，會為了一嚐新菜色跑很遠。)
Sailors once relied on celestial navigation, using the stars to cross vast oceans without modern instruments. (過去水手依靠天體導航，利用星星在沒有現代儀器的情況下橫越廣大海洋。)
Only a few of the mushrooms growing in this forest are edible. (這座森林裡生長的蘑菇只有少數可食用。)

meaning: n. 微處理器；微處理裝置
example: A modern microprocessor handles millions of operations per second, yet it consumes very little power. (現代微處理器每秒能處理數百萬次運算，耗電量卻很低。)
The pilot had to deviate from the planned route to avoid the storm. (機師必須偏離預定航線，以避開暴風雨。)
Farmers and wildlife can coexist if corridors are left between fields and forests. (如果在農田與森林之間保留通道，農民和野生動物就能共存。)
She trained in accountancy before joining a firm that audits small charities. (她在進入一家審計小型慈善機構的公司前，接受會計訓練。)
Her prowess at repairing clocks often surprises visitors. (她修理鐘錶的高超技藝常讓訪客驚訝。)
The machine ejects the finished metal parts onto a conveyor belt below. (機器把完成的金屬零件彈落到下方的輸送帶上。)
The cathedral is admired for the majesty of its stained glass windows. (這座大教堂以其彩繪玻璃窗的壯觀而備受讚賞。)
Lack of sleep made him irritable and unusually quick to argue with colleagues. (睡眠不足讓他易怒，而且異常容易和同事爭執。)
He filled a flask with hot tea for the long walk home. (他裝了一瓶熱茶，準備走長路回家。)

meaning:
n. 血塊；凝塊
v. 凝結；結塊
example: Long flights increase the risk of a blood clot, so doctors often advise passengers to walk around regularly. (長途飛行會增加血栓風險，因此醫師常建議乘客定期起身走動。)

meaning:
n. 紫外線
adj. 紫外線的；紫外的

Most ordinary plastic does not decompose quickly, which is why it persists in the deep ocean for centuries. (大多數普通塑膠不會快速分解，這就是它能在深海中存在數百年的原因。)
Farming is difficult in arid regions where rainfall is low and unpredictable. (在降雨少且難以預測的乾燥地區，耕作十分困難。)

meaning:
adj. 平等主義的；平等的
n. 平等主義者；平等主義
example: The community was founded on egalitarian principles, with all members sharing the work. (這個社群以平等主義原則創立，所有成員分擔工作。)

meaning: adj. 有道德的；品德高尚的
example: She was regarded as a virtuous leader who refused to accept gifts. (她被認為是一位有道德、拒收禮物的領導者。)

He was charged with treason after passing military secrets to a foreign government. (他因把軍事機密交給外國政府而被控叛國罪。)

meaning: adj. 狡猾的；偷偷摸摸的
example: He gave a sly smile and refused to tell us where the keys were. (他狡猾地笑了一下，不肯告訴我們鑰匙在哪裡。)
He slowly recollected the names of the teachers who had taught him at school. (他慢慢想起那些曾在學校教過他的老師名字。)
The library keeps a facsimile of the original map in a glass case. (圖書館把原版地圖的複製品放在玻璃櫃中保存。)
Colourful graffiti detracts from the beauty of the old station, although some residents now see it as art. (色彩鮮豔的塗鴉減損了老車站的美感，不過有些居民現在把它視為藝術。)
A colossal statue of the former leader dominates the entrance to the park. (一座巨大的前領袖雕像矗立在公園入口。)
The country has invested heavily in aerospace research, hoping to create high-skilled jobs. (該國大力投資航太研究，希望創造高技術工作機會。)
Some shoppers travel far afield to find much cheaper building materials. (有些購物者會遠赴他鄉尋找便宜得多的建材。)
A family history of diabetes may predispose people to the illness, although daily diet remains very important. (糖尿病家族史可能讓人較容易罹患此病，不過日常飲食仍然很重要。)

City dwellers often pay more for a single small flat than nearby villagers pay for an entire house. (城市居民買一間小公寓的錢，往往比附近村民買一整棟房子還多。)
Incomplete combustion in the old wood stove produced thick smoke, filling the cottage within minutes. (舊木爐燃燒不完全，產生濃煙，幾分鐘內便瀰漫整間小屋。)

meaning:
adj. 選修的；選擇性的
n. 選修課；選修科目
example: Students can choose an elective in journalism if they have spare credits. (學生如果還有剩餘學分，可以選修一門新聞課程。)

meaning: adj. 不可逆的；無法挽回的
example: Damage to the coral reef may be irreversible, even if pollution is reduced. (即使減少汙染，珊瑚礁受到的損害也可能不可逆轉。)

meaning: adj. 有創意的；善創新的

The smell of fresh bread pervaded the whole street in the early morning. (清晨時，新鮮麵包的香味瀰漫整條街。)

Her grandmother's cookery book contains faded but still useful handwritten notes beside almost every recipe. (祖母的烹飪書幾乎每道食譜旁都有褪色但仍有用的手寫筆記。)

meaning: n. 實地調查；田野工作
example: The geologist's fieldwork took her to dangerous remote volcanoes, where she carefully collected valuable rock samples for analysis. (這位地質學家的實地調查帶她到危險的偏遠火山，她在那裡仔細採集有價值的岩石樣本。)

meaning: adj. 軼事的；個案經驗的

The observatory on the mountain top is open to the public every weekend. (山頂的天文台每個週末都開放給民眾參觀。)

meaning: adj. 信譽良好的；可靠的
example: Always book through a reputable travel agency before paying a large deposit. (支付大筆訂金前，一定要透過信譽良好的旅行社訂位。)
A meteorite landed in a field and was later examined by university researchers. (一顆隕石落在田野裡，後來由大學研究人員檢驗。)
Workers dredged the shallow lake last winter, which greatly reduced the risk of spring flooding in nearby fields. (工人去年冬天疏浚了這座淺湖，大大降低了附近農田春季淹水的風險。)

meaning:
n. 平衡；制衡
v. 平衡；抵銷
example: Urban trees provide a natural counterbalance to rising temperatures in crowded cities. (都市樹木為擁擠城市中上升的氣溫提供天然的平衡。)

meaning:
adj. 理工科的；工科技術的
n. 理工學院；工科大學
example: He studied design at a local polytechnic before starting his own studio. (他在理工學院讀設計，之後創立自己的工作室。)

A stone from a lorry cracked his windscreen on the motorway yesterday. (昨天在高速公路上，一顆從卡車掉下的石頭砸裂了他的擋風玻璃。)
The stony ground made it difficult to plant anything without heavy machinery. (多石的地面讓人在沒有機械的情況下很難種植作物。)

meaning: v. 接種疫苗；為…打預防針
example: Local clinics vaccinate children against several diseases before they start primary school each year. (各地診所每年在兒童進小學前為他們接種多種疾病的疫苗。)
It took her nearly an hour to decipher the doctor's handwritten notes. (她花了將近一小時才辨認出醫生手寫的筆記。)

meaning: adj. 博士的；博士研究的
example: She began her doctoral research on soil quality in local coastal wetlands. (她開始進行有關當地沿海濕地土壤品質的博士研究。)
The cashier carefully counted the large notes twice before handing over the correct change. (收銀員仔細數了兩次大鈔，才把正確的零錢遞出去。)
The novelist died in obscurity, though her books are now widely read. (這位小說家去世時默默無聞，儘管她的書現在廣受閱讀。)
He wore a heavy overcoat and a wool scarf against the cold wind. (他穿著厚重的大衣、圍著羊毛圍巾來抵擋寒風。)

meaning:

Short gentle walking after meals can aid the digestive system, though many people simply prefer to lie down. (飯後短暫溫和地散步有助消化系統，不過許多人就是寧願躺下來。)

meaning: adj. 激勵的；鼓舞人心的
example: The workshop included a short motivational talk about setting realistic career goals. (這場工作坊包含一場關於設定實際職涯目標的簡短激勵演講。)

meaning: adj. 地震的；地震活動的
example: The building was strengthened to withstand seismic activity common in the region. (這棟建築已補強，以承受該地區常見的地震活動。)

meaning: adj. 各式各樣的；雜項的
example: The drawer was full of miscellaneous items, including old keys and broken watches. (抽屜裡塞滿各式各樣的東西，包括舊鑰匙和壞掉的手錶。)

meaning:
adj. 十進制的；小數的
n. 小數；十進小數
example: The answer should be given to two decimal places, as the instructions state. (依照指示，答案應寫到小數點後兩位。)

meaning: n. 填字遊戲；縱橫字謎
example: Teachers sometimes use a simple crossword to review vocabulary, especially on the last day before a short holiday. (教師有時會用簡單的填字遊戲複習單字，尤其是在短假前的最後一天。)

meaning:
v. 模仿；比手畫腳
n. 默劇；啞劇
example: The toddler mimed feeding an elephant, holding an imaginary bucket above his head. (幼童模仿餵大象的動作，將想像中的水桶高舉過頭。)
He was unfairly called a coward for refusing to join the others in the fighting. (他因拒絕和其他人一起投入戰鬥，而被不公平地稱為懦夫。)

meaning: vt. 使全神貫注；使著迷
example: The chess match engrossed the old men for most of the afternoon. (這場西洋棋賽讓老人們整個下午幾乎全神貫注。)
Her rendition of the old song moved several people in the audience to tears. (她對這首老歌的詮釋讓觀眾席上好幾個人落淚。)

meaning: n. 博士學位；博士課程
example: She began a doctorate in marine biology after spending two years recording fish populations on remote coral reefs. (她在偏遠珊瑚礁記錄魚類族群兩年後，開始攻讀海洋生物學博士學位。)
The exuberant growth of climbing vines soon covered the whole back wall. (攀藤繁茂生長，很快覆蓋了整面後牆。)
A severe stroke left the elderly farmer with partial paralysis on his left side. (一場嚴重的中風讓這位老農夫左側身體局部癱瘓。)
The redevelopment of the old gasworks will finally provide new homes, but rents are expected to be high. (老瓦斯廠的重新開發終於將提供新住宅，但預期租金會很高。)
The seeds germinate only after the first heavy rains of the season. (這些種子只會在該季第一場大雨後發芽。)
The phrase was purely metaphorical, not a literal description of the journey. (這句話是隱喻，不是對旅程的字面描述。)
The old atlas shows the mountains, rivers and main roads of the region. (這本舊地圖冊標示了該地區的山脈、河流和主要道路。)
The agency accredits only those laboratories that meet its strict safety standards. (該機構只認證符合其嚴格安全標準的實驗室。)
Lax safety standards at the factory were partly blamed for the accident. (工廠不嚴格的安全標準被歸咎為事故原因。)
Fraudsters often perpetrate their crimes by pretending to be trusted government officials. (詐騙集團常假冒可信賴的官員來犯案。)

meaning: adj. 卑鄙的；令人作嘔的
example: The smell from the blocked drain was so vile that residents kept their windows shut. (堵塞排水管散發的味道糟透了，居民都緊閉窗戶。)
He has only a rudimentary knowledge of French but communicates well enough. (他的法語只有基本程度，但溝通還算順利。)
The tsunami warning system gave coastal residents nearly an hour to reach higher ground. (海嘯警報系統讓沿海居民有將近一小時撤往高處。)
It was considerate of him to call before arriving so late at night. (他那麼晚才到，還先打電話，實在很體諒人。)
He showed an early aptitude for music, so his parents found him a patient local teacher. (他很早就展現音樂天賦，因此父母替他找了一位有耐心的當地老師。)
A wreath of white flowers was laid at the war memorial on Sunday. (星期天有人在戰爭紀念碑前獻上一個白色花圈。)
The school does not condone bullying, and any complaint is investigated immediately. (學校不縱容霸凌，任何投訴都會立即調查。)
The male bird performs an elaborate courtship dance beside the small nest. (雄鳥在小小的巢旁跳起繁複的求偶舞。)

meaning:
v. 發酵；醞釀
n. 發酵；發酵物
example: The mixture is left to ferment for several days before it is bottled. (混合物在裝瓶前會先放置數天發酵。)
Rivers are replenished by rainfall and melting snow from the high mountains. (河流由山區的降雨和融雪補充。)
The rural clinic keeps an antidote for snake bites, but supplies often run low during the rainy season. (這家鄉間診所備有蛇咬解毒劑，但雨季期間供應經常不足。)

meaning: n. 垃圾掩埋場；填埋場
example: The old landfill now collects methane gas, which is burned to directly generate electricity for nearby local homes. (舊垃圾掩埋場現在收集甲烷，燃燒後直接為附近民宅發電。)
The cello has a deep, warm sound that blends well with the human voice. (大提琴的聲音低沉溫暖，與人聲搭配得很好。)
Airport cameras now automatically scan the iris to confirm an international traveller's identity without requiring a printed passport. (機場攝影機現在會自動掃描虹膜，確認國際旅客身分，不必出示紙本護照。)

meaning: adj. 可辨別的；可察覺的
example: The difference between the two treatments was barely discernible to most patients. (對大多數病患而言，兩種療法之間的差異幾乎無法辨別。)
The exodus of young families has left the village with few children. (年輕家庭大批離去，使村裡幾乎沒有小孩。)
The propeller was badly damaged by something under the surface of the water. (螺旋槳被水面下的某個東西嚴重損壞。)
A benevolent local employer paid her medical costs during the long absence. (一位仁慈的當地雇主在她長期缺席期間替她支付醫療費用。)
Poor sanitation in crowded refugee camps increases the risk of serious disease. (擁擠的難民營衛生設施差，增加了嚴重疾病的風險。)
His righteous anger at the injustice inspired others to join the protest. (他對不公不義的正義之怒，激勵其他人加入抗議。)

meaning:
adj. 豪華的；柔軟的
n. 長毛絨；絨布
example: The new plush office impressed visitors, although the staff working there constantly complained about the lack of daylight. (豪華的新辦公室讓訪客印象深刻，但在那裡工作的員工不斷抱怨缺乏日光。)
Shoppers jostled for space at the noisy market stall, eager to buy the last few fresh fish. (購物者在吵雜的市場攤位前推擠，急著買下最後幾條新鮮魚。)

meaning: vt. 使熟悉環境；使適應
example: The university runs a week of activities to orientate new students, including short tours and free language help. (大學舉辦一週活動幫助新生適應，包括簡短校園導覽和免費語言協助。)
Short leather jackets are in vogue this season, especially among younger shoppers. (短版皮夾克這一季很流行，尤其在年輕消費者之間。)
The old quarter teems with cheap small restaurants, which makes it very popular with students on a budget. (舊城區滿是便宜的小餐館，因此很受預算有限的學生歡迎。)
Thick smog covered the capital for days, forcing schools to keep children indoors. (濃厚霧霾籠罩首都數日，學校被迫讓孩子留在室內。)
The children wore bright raincoats and rubber boots on the walk to school. (孩子們穿著鮮豔的雨衣和橡膠雨鞋走路去上學。)
Inspectors closed the restaurant because the sanitary conditions in its kitchen were far below the required legal standard. (稽查人員勒令餐廳停業，因為廚房的衛生條件遠低於法定標準。)
It was unkind to laugh at the new student's pronunciation during the lesson. (上課時嘲笑新生的發音，是很刻薄的行為。)
Students from across the Commonwealth compete for a small number of research scholarships. (來自大英國協各地的學生，角逐為數不多的研究獎學金。)
She was indignant when the shop refused to replace the faulty machine. (店家拒絕更換故障機器時，她感到十分憤慨。)
Some dog owners pamper their pets outrageously, buying expensive special beds and cooking fresh meals every single day. (有些狗主人過度寵愛寵物，買昂貴的專用床，還每天烹煮新鮮餐食。)
Television documentaries have helped popularize regional cuisine among younger audiences at home and abroad. (電視紀錄片協助在國內外年輕觀眾間推廣地方料理。)
Progress on the new bridge has been glacial, and frustrated commuters have started organising peaceful weekly protests outside town hall. (新橋工程進度極為緩慢，受挫的通勤族開始每週在市政廳外和平抗議。)
Rapid urbanization has reduced farmland around the city and increased traffic congestion. (快速都市化減少城市周邊農地，也加劇交通壅塞。)
Free divers slowly exhale as they rise, releasing tiny bubbles that trail behind them towards the bright surface. (自由潛水員上升時慢慢吐氣，細小氣泡隨後飄向明亮的水面。)
A sudden downpour flooded the busy underground station, forcing commuters to wait outside until the water slowly drained. (突如其來的暴雨淹沒繁忙的地下車站，通勤族被迫在外等到積水慢慢退去。)
The children were completely mesmerized by the lights and music of the performance. (孩子們完全被演出的燈光和音樂迷住了。)
The financial meltdown of 2008 cost millions of people their jobs and homes. (2008年的金融崩潰讓數百萬人失去工作和住所。)
Owls and bats are nocturnal animals that hunt after sunset. (貓頭鷹和蝙蝠都是夜行性動物，會在日落後覓食。)

meaning:
adj. 可耕的；適耕的
n. 耕地；可耕地
example: Local arable farming depends on healthy soil, yet intensive methods often remove nutrients faster than nature replaces them. (當地的耕作仰賴健康土壤，但集約農法移除養分的速度往往快於自然補充。)
The trust hopes to rehabilitate the old dock into a public market. (這個基金會希望修復舊碼頭，將它改建成公共市場。)

meaning:
adj. 兩倍的；雙重的
adv. 兩倍地；雙重地
example: The study found a twofold increase in allergies, though the reasons remain unclear and require further careful research. (研究發現過敏案例增加為兩倍，不過原因仍不清楚，需要進一步仔細研究。)

meaning: adj. 操縱的；善於操控的
example: His manipulative behaviour made colleagues distrust every seemingly friendly gesture he offered. (他操縱他人的行為，讓同事不相信他每個看似友善的舉動。)
Every camper was warned about the sudden storm, yet several tents were still badly damaged during the night. (每位露營者都收到突發暴風雨的警告，但夜裡仍有幾頂帳篷嚴重受損。)
The arduous climb took six hours and left the walkers completely exhausted. (那趟艱辛的攀登花了六小時，讓健行者筋疲力盡。)
The announcer warned passengers that the train would be delayed by thirty minutes. (播報員提醒乘客，火車將延誤三十分鐘。)

meaning:
v. 故障；失靈
n. 故障；失靈
example: The machine malfunctioned twice, so production was delayed by almost a full day. (機器故障兩次，因此生產延誤了將近一整天。)
The path sparkled because it was mixed with fine crushed white quartz. (小徑混有細碎的白色石英，因此閃閃發亮。)
Noble gases are largely inert and rarely react with other chemical substances. (惰性氣體大多不活潑，很少與其他化學物質反應。)
The whole kitchen smelled of aromatic spices that reminded her of home. (廚房裡瀰漫著芳香的香料味，讓她想起家鄉。)
Countries near the equator receive roughly twelve hours of daylight all year round. (赤道附近的國家全年大約都有十二小時日照。)
The new agreement helped solidify long-term cooperation between the two research teams. (新協議有助於鞏固兩個研究團隊的長期合作。)
The work was monotonous, so he listened to podcasts to stay awake. (這份工作很單調，所以他聽播客保持清醒。)
Critics say the new law would legitimize a practice that harms consumers. (批評者表示，新法將使一種傷害消費者的做法合法化。)
The new tax was deeply unpopular with a large part of the populace. (這項新稅令很大一部分民眾深感不滿。)
A single volt is enough to light this very tiny glass lamp. (只要一伏特就足以點亮這盞極小的玻璃燈。)
His decision to sell the family home estranged him from his younger brother. (他賣掉老家的決定，讓他與弟弟疏遠了。)
They spent the evening playing billiards in a small hall near the station. (他們在車站附近的小撞球館打了一整晚撞球。)
The railway embankment collapsed after weeks of heavy rain, so local replacement buses ran for the entire month. (連日豪雨數週後，鐵路路堤崩塌，當地接駁巴士因此整整行駛了一個月。)
The crowded train was so hot and stuffy that several passengers stood near the doors for fresh air. (擁擠的火車又熱又悶，好幾名乘客站到車門旁呼吸新鮮空氣。)
A consignment of winter coats arrived after the unexpected cold spell, so the shop reduced them by half. (一批冬季外套在意外寒流過後才送到，因此店家把它們降價一半出清。)
The elderly landlady lives downstairs and keeps the shared back garden tidy all year round. (年長的女房東住在樓下，全年把共用的後花園整理得很整齊。)
The hospital's accreditation depends on regular inspections, so staff spend weeks carefully preparing documents before every single visit. (醫院認證取決於定期稽查，因此員工在每次稽查前都花好幾週仔細準備文件。)
A heavy bough fell across the road during the storm, blocking traffic. (暴風雨期間，一根粗大樹枝倒在路上，阻斷交通。)
Debt can enslave families for generations if interest rates remain extremely high. (如果利率一直居高不下，債務可能讓家庭世世代代受到奴役。)
She chose to forgo her daily lunch break so that the important report could be finished on time. (她選擇放棄每天的午休，好讓重要報告能準時完成。)
The building has no pretensions, offering simple honest rooms that stay cool in summer and warm in winter. (這棟建築毫不矯飾，提供樸實的房間，夏天涼爽、冬天溫暖。)

meaning:
adj. 四倍的；四重的
n. 四倍；四人組
v. 增至四倍；使成四倍
example: House prices in the area have quadrupled since the new railway opened. (新鐵路通車後，該地區房價已漲為四倍。)

meaning: adj. 未註冊的；未登記的
example: The unregistered charity collected public donations for months before officials questioned its legality. (這家未註冊的慈善機構公開募款數月後，官員才質疑其合法性。)
His explanation was clear and intelligible even to readers without a science background. (他的解釋清楚易懂，即使沒有科學背景的讀者也能理解。)
The morning trains are usually punctual, except during periods of heavy snow. (早班火車通常很準時，除非遇到大雪。)
He tends to embellish his stories, so listeners never know what really happened. (他說話喜歡加油添醋，聽眾永遠不知道真正發生了什麼。)
Poor eyesight among older drivers is checked every two years in many countries. (在許多國家，年長駕駛人的視力每兩年檢查一次。)
The theatre troupe tours small remote villages, performing in halls that have no proper stage or even lighting. (這個劇團巡演偏遠小村，在沒有正式舞台、甚至沒有燈光的禮堂裡演出。)
The physiotherapist adjusted the treadmill slowly so the patient could rebuild strength without straining her knee. (物理治療師慢慢調整跑步機，讓病人恢復肌力而不傷到膝蓋。)
New housing developments continue to encroach on farmland around the edge of the city. (新的住宅開發案持續侵占城市邊緣的農地。)
Fresh vegetables are highly nutritious, yet many families still buy cheaper processed food. (新鮮蔬菜營養豐富，但許多家庭仍購買較便宜的加工食品。)
He spent years trying to avenge his brother's death, which destroyed his family. (他花了多年想為弟弟的死報仇，卻毀了自己的家庭。)

meaning: adj. 物質主義的；重物質的
example: Critics say advertising constantly makes children materialistic, although parents can counter this by discussing needs and wants openly. (批評者說廣告不斷讓孩子變得物質主義，不過父母可以公開討論需求與欲望來抗衡。)
Good financial advice should be truly unbiased, yet many advisers earn secret commission from the products they recommend. (理想的理財建議應真正公正，但許多顧問會從推薦產品中賺取祕密佣金。)
The storm showed no sign of abating, so all flights were cancelled. (風暴沒有減弱的跡象，因此所有航班都取消了。)
Astronomers study the cosmos to understand how galaxies form and change over time. (天文學家研究宇宙，以了解星系如何形成並隨時間改變。)
The waitress set the cutlery neatly on the table before the guests arrived. (服務生在客人抵達前把餐具整齊擺在桌上。)
I missed the beginning, but the gist of his argument was clear. (我錯過開頭，但他論點的要點很清楚。)
The school treats minor deviance, such as unpolished shoes, as a serious matter, which surprises many new pupils. (學校把鞋子沒擦亮這類輕微越軌行為當成嚴重問題，讓許多新生感到驚訝。)

meaning:
v. 隔離；檢疫
n. 隔離；檢疫
example: Travellers from affected areas must quarantine at home for fourteen days after arrival. (來自疫區的旅客抵達後必須在家隔離十四天。)
The spaceship carried four astronauts to the space station and returned a week later. (那艘太空船載著四名太空人前往太空站，一週後返回。)

meaning:
n. 船槳；划槳
v. 划船；用槳划
example: He lost an oar, and the boat began to drift towards the rocks. (他掉了一支船槳，小船開始漂向岩石。)
Heavy overnight rain inundated low-lying villages and cut off several main roads. (整夜豪雨淹沒低窪村落，並中斷了幾條主要道路。)
How to fund care for the growing elderly population remains a thorny political question. (如何為日益增加的老年人口提供照護經費，仍是棘手的政治問題。)
Tourists rarely visit the hinterland, although its quiet villages and old churches are well worth the long journey. (遊客很少走訪內陸地區，儘管當地寧靜的村莊和古老教堂很值得長途造訪。)
Molten rock flowed down the slope and forced nearby villagers to flee. (熔岩沿山坡流下，迫使附近村民撤離。)

meaning:
v. 睡眠；沉睡
n. 睡眠；安睡
example: The quiet village slumbered peacefully under a thick blanket of fresh snow. (寧靜的村莊在厚厚的新雪下安然沉睡。)

meaning: adj. 自命不凡的；矯飾的
example: The menu was pretentious, full of French terms that few customers understood. (那份菜單矯飾做作，滿是顧客看不懂的法文。)

meaning: adj. 煞費苦心的；費力的
example: Restoring the damaged painting was painstaking work that took nearly four years. (修復受損畫作是件煞費苦心的工作，花了將近四年。)
Rising salinity in the river threatens local fish, so farmers upstream are being paid to use less water. (河川鹽度上升威脅當地魚類，因此上游農民可獲補助以減少用水。)
Visitors can climb the turret of the castle for a view over the bay. (遊客可以爬上城堡的小塔，眺望整個海灣。)

meaning:
n. 雪橇；雪車
vi. 乘雪橇；滑雪橇
example: The children pulled a small wooden sledge up the hill, then raced down together laughing until the winter sunset. (孩子們把小木雪橇拉上山丘，接著一起笑著滑下山，直到冬日夕陽西下。)
Fish take in oxygen from the water through their gills rather than through lungs. (魚透過鰓從水中吸取氧氣，而不是透過肺。)
He carefully cut a thin sliver of cheese from the block, leaving the rest for his older sister. (他小心地從整塊起司切下一薄片，其餘留給姊姊。)
The hospitable family welcomed exchange students, cooking local dishes and showing them around the town. (這家人熱情接待交換學生，為他們烹煮當地菜餚，並帶他們參觀城鎮。)
Apart from a minor mishap with the luggage, the journey went smoothly. (除了行李出了點小狀況，這趟旅程還算順利。)
The street gained notoriety after several expensive cars were stolen there in one month. (這條街一個月內有好幾輛高價汽車被偷，因此聲名狼藉。)
The harvest failed again, bringing fresh calamity to families already struggling with debt. (收成再度失敗，為原本就苦苦支撐的家庭帶來新的災難。)
The team surmounted several technical problems before the bridge was finally opened. (橋梁終於通車前，團隊克服了好幾項技術問題。)
It is unfair to disparage workers who have little control over company policy. (貶低幾乎無權左右公司政策的員工並不公平。)

meaning:
n. 新月；月牙
adj. 新月形的；彎月形的
example: The bakery sells freshly baked crescent rolls every morning, and they are usually gone before nine. (這家麵包店每天早上販售新鮮出爐的新月形麵包，通常九點前就賣光了。)
The bank charges high interest on an overdraft, so he tried to repay it before the end of the month. (銀行對透支收取高額利息，因此他試著在月底前還清。)
The two sisters constantly try to outdo each other, comparing exam results at every family dinner. (兩姊妹不斷想勝過對方，每次家庭晚餐都會比較考試成績。)

meaning:
n. 淤泥；粉砂
v. 淤塞；積滿淤泥
example: The dam traps silt that once naturally fertilised the fields downstream, so farmers now rely on chemical fertilisers. (水壩攔住原本會自然滋養下游田地的淤泥，農民現在只能依賴化學肥料。)
The consulate refused his student visa application, explaining that one required document was still missing. (領事館拒絕了他的學生簽證申請，並說明其中一份必要文件仍未繳交。)

meaning: n. 物質主義；唯物主義
example: Some critics argue that materialism has replaced religion as the main source of values. (有些評論者認為，物質主義已取代宗教成為價值觀的主要來源。)

meaning: adj. 互相依賴的；相互依存的
example: Modern economies are deeply interdependent, so a serious shortage in one country quickly affects many factories in others. (現代經濟體深度互相依賴，因此一國的嚴重短缺會迅速影響其他國家的許多工廠。)

meaning: n. 三學期制；三個月期
example: The school year is divided into three trimesters, with a short break between each demanding period of study. (學年分為三個學期，每段繁重的學習期間之間都有短假。)
The prisoner said he had come to repent and to apologise to the family. (那名囚犯說他來懺悔，並向那家人道歉。)
Diligent workers often receive better pay and more opportunities for promotion than others. (勤奮的員工往往比其他人獲得更好的待遇和更多升遷機會。)
Doctors use morphine to relieve severe pain after major surgery or serious injury. (醫師用嗎啡來緩解大手術或重傷後的劇烈疼痛。)
He carefully checked the expiry date on his passport, discovering it would lapse during the upcoming long trip. (他仔細查看護照的有效期限，發現護照會在即將到來的長途旅行期間到期。)
Her insomnia worsened during the exam period, so she avoided coffee after lunch. (她的失眠在考試期間加重，所以午餐後就不喝咖啡。)
Their haphazard approach to planning caused many delays, although the result was unexpectedly good. (他們毫無計畫的規劃方式造成許多延誤，不過結果出乎意料地好。)

meaning: n. 主要衝擊；最大打擊
example: Small local shops bore the brunt of the recession, while larger chains still survived on much cheaper credit. (小型地方商店承受經濟衰退最大的衝擊，而大型連鎖店仍靠較便宜的貸款撐下來。)

meaning:
n. X光；X光片
v. 照X光；用X光檢查
example: The X-ray showed a small crack in the bone just above his wrist. (X光片顯示他手腕正上方的骨頭有一道小裂痕。)
Every kitchen should have a few basic utensils, such as a knife and a wooden spoon. (每個廚房都該有幾樣基本用具，例如一把刀和一支木匙。)

meaning: n. 野外旅行；觀獸旅行
example: They went on safari in Kenya and saw lions and elephants at close range. (他們到肯亞參加野生動物之旅，近距離看到獅子和大象。)
The disease is insidious because symptoms appear only after serious internal damage has occurred. (這種疾病很隱伏，因為嚴重的體內損害發生後症狀才會出現。)

meaning: adj. 無法逃避的；難以避免的
example: There was an inescapable smell of smoke in the old ruined house. (那棟破舊的廢屋裡有一股揮之不去的煙味。)
The museum hired a specialist to trace the provenance of the ancient bronze statue. (博物館聘請專家追查這座古代青銅雕像的來源。)

meaning: adj. 不協調的；不相稱的
example: The modern glass tower looks incongruous among the rows of old stone houses. (這棟現代玻璃高樓在一排排古老石屋之間顯得格格不入。)
Her disillusionment with the job grew steadily, and she resigned after six difficult months. (她對這份工作的幻滅感逐漸加深，經歷六個月的辛苦後便辭職了。)
The small ancient flint tool fits neatly in one hand, suggesting its maker probably used it every day. (這件小型古代燧石工具正好一手可握，顯示製作者很可能每天都使用它。)
The lorry broke down when its rear axle cracked on a rough road. (卡車的後車軸在崎嶇路面上裂開，因而拋錨。)
A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of heart disease and back pain. (久坐的生活型態會增加心臟病和背痛的風險。)

meaning: adj. 適得其反的；反效果的
example: Punishing employees harshly for honest mistakes is usually counterproductive and reduces trust. (嚴厲懲罰員工的無心之過通常適得其反，還會降低信任。)
Older people can stay agile by doing balance exercises several times a week. (年長者每週做幾次平衡運動，就能保持敏捷。)
Even superstitious people sometimes laugh at their own fear of lucky numbers. (即使是迷信的人，有時也會嘲笑自己對幸運數字的恐懼。)
He eats warm porridge with honey and fruit every morning before work. (他每天早上上班前都吃加蜂蜜和水果的熱燕麥粥。)
The film's storyline is simple, yet it raises difficult questions about family loyalty. (這部片的故事情節簡單，卻帶出關於家庭忠誠的難題。)

meaning:
n. 腦力激盪；集思廣益
v. 腦力激盪；集思廣益
example: The team spent an hour brainstorming ideas before choosing the most practical solution. (團隊花了一小時腦力激盪，才選出最實際的解決方案。)
The internship at a rural clinic taught her how to reassure patients who had never seen a specialist. (在鄉間診所的實習教會她如何安撫從未看過專科醫師的病人。)
Farmers domesticated wild grasses thousands of years ago to produce reliable grain crops. (數千年前，農民馴化野生禾草，培育出穩定的穀物作物。)

meaning: adj. 新古典主義的；新古典風格的
example: The museum is housed in a neoclassical building with tall columns and a grand entrance. (這座博物館設在一棟新古典風格的建築裡，具有高柱與宏偉入口。)
Every April the public gardens are filled with tulips of every colour. (每年四月，公園裡開滿各種顏色的鬱金香。)
She tried acupuncture for her back pain and felt relief within weeks. (她嘗試針灸治療背痛，幾週內就感覺舒緩。)
Hot magma rose slowly beneath the volcano for weeks before the eruption began. (火山爆發前，高溫岩漿在火山下方緩慢上升數週。)
His sudden resignation remains an enigma that colleagues still discuss years later. (他突然辭職仍是個謎，同事多年後還在討論。)
The factory released noxious fumes that affected residents living several streets away. (工廠排放的有害氣體影響到住在幾條街外的居民。)
The mason cut each stone by hand so that it fitted the wall. (石匠手工切割每塊石頭，讓它能密合地砌進牆裡。)

meaning: adj. 無比的；無與倫比的
example: The city offers unparalleled opportunities for young people starting careers in finance. (這座城市為投入金融業的年輕人提供無與倫比的機會。)
Thousands of families immigrate to the city each year in search of work. (每年有數千個家庭為了找工作而移入這座城市。)
A small ferry carries visitors to the isle three times a day. (一艘小型渡輪每天載訪客到小島三次。)
A dearth of affordable housing has forced many young workers to leave the city. (平價住宅缺乏，迫使許多年輕勞工離開這座城市。)
He met a compatriot in the very long queue, and they spent the entire afternoon talking about home. (他在長長的人龍中遇到一位同胞，兩人整個下午都在聊家鄉。)

meaning: n. 植物學家；植物學者
example: The botanist collected seeds from rare plants to store for future research. (這位植物學家採集稀有植物的種子，保存供未來研究。)
Strict regulations circumscribe how much water factories may draw from the river. (嚴格法規限制工廠能從河裡抽取的水量。)

meaning:
n. 口頭誹謗；中傷
vt. 誹謗；中傷
example: He sued the magazine for slander after it described him as dishonest. (那本雜誌稱他不誠實後，他控告對方誹謗。)
The manager's autocratic style discouraged experienced staff from suggesting any new ideas. (經理專制的作風讓資深員工不敢提出任何新想法。)

meaning: n. 生態學家；生態學者
example: Ecologists warn that building on the wetland would damage a fragile habitat. (生態學家警告，在濕地興建建築會破壞脆弱的棲地。)
Her eloquence impressed the audience, even though many disagreed with her argument. (她的雄辯令觀眾印象深刻，儘管許多人不同意她的論點。)
The hikers went astray in the fog and were found hours later. (登山客在霧中迷路，數小時後才被找到。)

meaning: adj. 隨之而來的；重要的
example: The storm caused little damage, but the consequential losses for farmers were severe. (暴風雨本身造成的損害不大，但農民隨之而來的損失很嚴重。)

meaning:
adj. 原住民的；土著的
n. 原住民；土著
example: Aboriginal communities have managed these lands sustainably for many thousands of years. (原住民社群以永續方式管理這些土地已數千年。)
Cheaper flights are a welcome byproduct of intense competition between rival airlines. (機票變便宜是航空公司激烈競爭下受歡迎的副產品。)
The viscous liquid flows very slowly through the narrow pipes during cold weather. (這種黏稠液體在寒冷天氣中流經窄管時速度很慢。)
Thick green vines entwine the old stone walls of the abandoned garden. (濃密的綠色藤蔓纏住廢棄花園的舊石牆。)

meaning:
n. 腐蝕劑；苛性物質
adj. 腐蝕性的；尖刻的
example: The critic's caustic remarks about the new play upset the young actors. (評論家對這齣新戲的尖酸批評讓年輕演員很難過。)
If a colleague helps you, it is polite to reciprocate when they need support. (如果同事幫助你，在他們需要支援時回報是種禮貌。)
She unwrapped the parcel carefully, keeping the brown paper for later use. (她小心拆開包裹，把牛皮紙留下來以後使用。)
Judicious use of water kept the small garden truly alive, even during the hottest and driest summer month. (明智地用水讓這座小花園維持生機，即使在最炎熱乾燥的夏季月份也一樣。)

meaning:
n. 有袋類；袋類動物
adj. 有袋類的；袋類的
example: The kangaroo is the largest marsupial and can survive long droughts on very little water. (袋鼠是體型最大的有袋類，能以很少的水分熬過長期乾旱。)
Drivers who disobey traffic signals put pedestrians and cyclists at serious risk. (不服從交通號誌的駕駛，會讓行人和自行車騎士面臨嚴重風險。)

meaning: adj. 無定形的；不成形的
example: The sculpture looks like an amorphous mass, yet many visitors keep stopping to photograph it. (這座雕塑看起來像一團無定形物體，但許多訪客仍停下來拍照。)
His career began to stagnate after the company merged, and he soon sought much fresher challenges somewhere else entirely. (公司合併後，他的事業開始停滯，於是很快便到別處尋找新的挑戰。)
The team carefully collated survey results from twelve schools before writing a short final report for the ministry. (團隊仔細整理十二所學校的調查結果，之後才為部會撰寫簡短的最終報告。)
Some critics believe the court was too lenient with the company directors. (有些批評者認為法院對那幾名公司董事太寬大。)
Migratory fish return to this river each spring, although dams have made the long upstream journey increasingly difficult. (洄游魚類每年春天都回到這條河，儘管水壩讓漫長的逆流旅程越來越困難。)
Critics described the new stadium as an extravagance the city could not afford. (批評者說新體育館是這座城市負擔不起的奢侈。)

meaning: adj. 赤貧的；一無所有的
example: The flood left thousands of local families completely destitute and dependent on emergency aid. (洪水讓數千個當地家庭一無所有，只能依賴緊急援助。)
Volunteers repainted the old school hall in bright colours during the holidays, using paints chosen by the pupils themselves. (志工在假期間用學生自己挑選的油漆，把老舊的學校禮堂重新漆成鮮豔的顏色。)
A herbivore's teeth are wide and flat for grinding plants, while a predator's are sharp for tearing meat. (食草動物的牙齒寬而平，用來磨碎植物；掠食者的牙齒則尖銳，用來撕肉。)

meaning:
adj. 北極的；極冷的
n. 北極地區
example: Arctic temperatures are rising much faster than the global average, scientists warn. (科學家警告，北極氣溫上升的速度快於全球平均。)
Many newspapers still print astrology columns, even though scientists doubt their accuracy. (許多報紙仍刊登占星術專欄，儘管科學家懷疑它們的準確性。)
Large carnivores need wide territories, which brings them into conflict with farmers. (大型肉食動物需要廣大領域，因而與農民發生衝突。)

meaning: adj. 不在乎的；漠不關心的
example: She seemed surprisingly unconcerned about failing the final exam, although her parents were deeply worried. (她對期末考不及格似乎出奇地不在意，儘管父母非常擔心。)
The wedding was surprisingly opulent, with fresh flowers in every corner and a live band that played until sunrise. (這場婚禮豪華得令人意外，每個角落都有鮮花，還有現場樂團演奏到日出。)

meaning: n. 磚造部分；砌磚工程
example: The brickwork on the front of the old house was repaired last summer. (這棟老屋正面的磚造部分去年夏天整修過。)
Rescuers searched the frigid mountains for two climbers reported missing on Friday. (救援人員在寒冷的山區搜尋週五通報失蹤的兩名登山客。)
A tall pagoda stands on the hill and can be seen from miles away. (一座高聳的寶塔矗立在山丘上，幾英里外就能看見。)
The school is a small microcosm of society, where friendships and conflicts form every day with surprising speed. (學校是社會的小縮影，友誼與衝突每天都在其中以驚人的速度形成。)
Farmers depend on the monsoon to water their rice fields each summer. (農民每年夏天都靠雨季的雨水灌溉稻田。)
The cave served as a temporary abode for shepherds, who moved their flocks to lower ground in winter. (這座山洞曾是牧羊人的臨時住所，他們在冬天把羊群趕往較低的地區。)
Some frogs survive the long dry season in dormancy, emerging only when the first heavy rains finally arrive. (有些青蛙以休眠狀態度過漫長的乾季，直到第一場大雨終於來臨才現身。)
She liaises with overseas suppliers daily, ensuring that every crucial order arrives before the busy Christmas season. (她每天與海外供應商聯絡，確保每筆重要訂單都能在繁忙的耶誕季前送達。)
The young veterinarian treats injured wild birds for free, which has quietly made her a much-loved local hero. (這位年輕獸醫免費治療受傷的野鳥，悄悄讓她成為深受喜愛的當地英雄。)

meaning:
adj. 催眠的；令人入迷的
n. 安眠藥
example: The steady rhythm of the waves had a hypnotic effect on us. (海浪穩定的節奏對我們有催眠般的效果。)
The pace of house building began to slacken as interest rates rose. (隨著利率上升，住宅建設的速度開始放慢。)
The family built a thriving business through industrious work over three generations. (這個家族靠三代人勤奮工作，建立起興旺的事業。)
Warm air rises through convection, which explains why heaters are placed near the floor. (暖空氣透過對流上升，這說明了暖氣為何裝在地板附近。)
The documentary reveals the barbaric conditions inside the former prison on the island. (這部紀錄片揭露島上舊監獄內野蠻的環境。)

meaning: n. 嚴重性；重大；滔天罪行
example: She did not fully understand the enormity of the decision until several years later. (直到好幾年後，她才完全理解這個決定有多重大。)
The poem speaks of everlasting love that survives distance and the passing years. (這首詩談的是永恆的愛，能超越距離和流逝的歲月。)

meaning: adj. 未被發現的；未察覺的
example: The illness can quietly go undetected for years, which is why regular screening matters so much. (這種疾病可能悄悄潛伏多年而未被發現，因此定期篩檢非常重要。)

meaning: adj. 大膽的；膽大妄為的
example: Her audacious question surprised the whole panel, although it eventually led to a serious discussion about much-needed funding. (她那句大膽的提問讓整個評審團大吃一驚，不過最後也促成了關於亟需經費的認真討論。)

meaning: adj. 榮譽退休的；名譽的
example: The emeritus professor still visits the department regularly to supervise postgraduate students. (這位榮譽退休教授仍會到系上指導研究生。)
He was mortified when he realised he had called his new boss by the wrong name. (他發現自己叫錯新老闆的名字時，覺得非常難堪。)
Photosynthesis allows green plants to convert sunlight into chemical energy for growth. (光合作用讓綠色植物把陽光轉換成生長所需的化學能。)
A chance meeting at the market rekindled their friendship after many years. (市場上的一次巧遇讓他們多年後重燃友誼。)
As a quiet introvert, he often carefully shares his best ideas in writing rather than at long meetings. (身為安靜的內向者，他常仔細以書面分享最佳想法，而不是在冗長會議上發言。)

meaning: adj. 善變的；反覆無常的
example: Public taste is fickle, so restaurants that follow every sudden fashion often struggle to keep loyal long-term customers. (大眾口味善變，因此追逐每一股突然流行風潮的餐廳，往往難以留住忠實的長期顧客。)

meaning:
n. 消毒劑；抗菌劑
adj. 消毒的；抗菌的
example: Clean the cut with antiseptic before covering it with a clean plaster. (先用抗菌劑清潔傷口，再貼上乾淨的OK繃。)
Preventative checks on the water pipes saved the town a costly repair. (對水管做預防性檢查，為鎮上省下一筆昂貴的維修費。)
The child's chronic bronchitis improved after the family finally moved to a drier flat away from the motorway. (這家人終於搬到遠離高速公路、較乾燥的公寓後，孩子的慢性支氣管炎就好轉了。)

meaning: adj. 煽動性的；縱火的；燃燒的
example: An incendiary post spread quickly online, and senior officials struggled to calm the public anger it created. (一則煽動性貼文迅速在網路上傳開，資深官員難以平息它引發的民憤。)

meaning: adj. 骯髒的；滿是汙垢的
example: Tired workers emerged from the mine with grimy faces and exhausted expressions. (礦工從礦坑出來，臉上積滿汙垢，神情疲憊。)

meaning: adj. 不可撤銷的；無法挽回的
example: Her resignation was irrevocable, so the board reluctantly began searching for a suitable replacement early the next morning. (她的辭職不可撤銷，因此董事會隔天一早便不情願地開始尋找合適接替人選。)
The cost of housing in the city centre is prohibitive for young families. (市中心的住房成本對年輕家庭來說高得令人望而卻步。)
The engine produces enough horsepower to pull very heavy loads up steep hills. (這具引擎的馬力足以把極重的貨物拉上陡坡。)
The escalator at the metro station breaks down almost daily, which makes life very difficult for elderly passengers. (捷運站的電扶梯幾乎天天故障，讓年長乘客的生活非常不方便。)
Fallow land provides useful shelter for nesting birds, which is why some farmers deliberately leave a strip untilled. (休耕地為築巢的鳥提供有用的庇護，因此有些農民刻意留一條未耕的帶狀地。)
Tourists often pay exorbitant prices for simple meals near the main square. (遊客常在主廣場附近為簡單餐點支付不合理的高價。)
The committee must decide how to apportion the limited funds among the projects. (委員會必須決定如何在各項計畫間分配有限經費。)
Better portion planning has cut wastage in the restaurant kitchen, saving money and reducing the amount sent to landfill. (更妥善的分量規劃減少了餐廳廚房的損耗，既省錢又減少送往掩埋場的垃圾量。)
The editor resigned after clear plagiarism was found in three articles, and the paper published a full apology. (三篇文章被查出明顯抄襲後，編輯辭職，報社也刊登了完整道歉。)
The test included an aural section in which students listened to short recordings. (這項測驗包含聽覺部分，學生要聽幾段簡短錄音。)

meaning: n. 相互關係；相互關聯
example: The interrelationship between climate and farming is very complex, which makes long-term planning difficult for small remote villages. (氣候與農業之間的相互關聯非常複雜，這讓偏遠小村莊難以做長期規劃。)
Sailors in the past used the stars to estimate their longitude while crossing the ocean. (過去的水手在橫渡大洋時，會利用星辰估算經度。)
Interstellar dust can dim the light from stars and make observations difficult. (星際塵埃會使星光變暗，讓觀測變得困難。)

meaning: adj. 無敵的；無可匹敵的
example: The team seemed unbeatable until a series of injuries weakened its defence. (這支球隊在接連的傷兵削弱防線前，似乎無人能敵。)

meaning: n. 自動販賣機；分配器
example: The automatic dispenser in the corridor ran out of drinks, so staff had to use the machine downstairs. (走廊上的自動販賣機飲料賣完了，員工只好去用樓下那台機器。)
Her business acumen turned a tiny shop into a thriving local chain. (她的商業敏銳度把一家小店變成蓬勃發展的在地連鎖店。)
Her decision to donate the entire prize money seemed genuinely altruistic rather than strategic. (她決定把全部獎金捐出去，看起來是真心無私，而非策略考量。)
It was heartless of the landlord to evict the elderly couple in winter. (房東在冬天驅逐那對年老夫婦，實在很無情。)
She studied botany at university and later worked on crop disease research. (她大學念植物學，後來從事作物病害研究。)
Gunpowder was invented in China and later changed the nature of warfare entirely. (火藥在中國發明，後來徹底改變了戰爭的性質。)

meaning: vt. 使癱瘓；使喪失能力
example: The snowstorm completely incapacitated the major railway network, leaving thousands of commuters stranded at busy city stations overnight. (暴風雪讓主要鐵路網完全癱瘓，數千名通勤族整夜受困在繁忙的市區車站。)
The government agreed to repatriate the migrant workers stranded at the border. (政府同意遣返滯留邊界的移工。)
Humans are naturally gregarious creatures who generally prefer company to complete solitude. (人類天生是群居動物，通常偏好有人陪伴而非完全獨處。)
The new engine uses electric propulsion, which is far more efficient than chemical rockets. (新引擎採用電力推進，效率遠高於化學火箭。)
Earthworms improve the soil by pulling dead leaves down into their burrows. (蚯蚓把枯葉拉進洞穴，改善土壤。)
Workers used a simple pulley to lift heavy tiles onto the roof of the tower. (工人用簡單的滑輪把沉重的屋瓦吊上塔樓屋頂。)

meaning:
vt. 徵用；徵收
n. 申請單；徵用
example: The council requisitioned the empty old hotel, using it to house local families left homeless by the flood. (市議會徵用這間空置的老飯店，用來安置因洪水失去住所的當地家庭。)

meaning: adj. 一絲不苟的；嚴謹的；有良心的
example: Scrupulous record keeping is essential for any laboratory that handles dangerous chemicals. (嚴謹的紀錄保存對任何處理危險化學品的實驗室都至關重要。)
She remained steadfast in her support for the project despite the criticism. (儘管受到批評，她仍堅定支持這項計畫。)

meaning: n. 不透明；不透明度；晦澀
example: The opacity of the glass can be adjusted to protect the privacy of patients. (玻璃的不透明度可以調整，以保護病患的隱私。)
Long periods of introspection helped him understand why he had left teaching. (長時間的內省幫助他理解自己為何離開教職。)
The venomous snake is rarely seen, but its bite can be fatal. (這種毒蛇很少被看到，但被咬可能致命。)
She felt pure exhilaration as the boat raced across the open bay. (小船疾駛過開闊的海灣時，她感到純粹的興奮。)
The elderly patients suffered the indignity of being left in wet clothes for hours. (這些年長病患被丟著穿濕衣服好幾個小時，毫無尊嚴。)

meaning: adj. 不顯眼的；不張揚的
example: The hotel's unobtrusive service made guests feel comfortable rather than constantly watched. (飯店不張揚的服務讓客人感到舒適，而不是一直被盯著。)
Farmers misjudged the early frost and lost most of the fruit, which pushed prices up across the region. (農民誤判提早到來的霜害，損失大部分水果，導致整個地區價格上漲。)

meaning: adj. 斷斷續續的；插曲式的
example: Her career has been episodic, with long periods of unemployment between projects. (她的職涯斷斷續續，專案之間常有長時間的失業。)

meaning: adj. 人文主義的；人本的
example: The school's humanistic approach emphasises creativity and cooperation rather than endless testing. (這所學校的人文主義方針強調創造力與合作，而非無止境的考試。)
A tiny bistro opened beside the river, serving simple cheap food to walkers and cyclists throughout the summer. (河邊開了一家小餐館，整個夏天為健行者和自行車族提供簡單便宜的食物。)
Leave your wet coat in the cloakroom before you go upstairs to eat. (上樓用餐前，把溼外套放在衣帽間。)
Illiteracy remains stubbornly high in remote areas where few schools are available. (在學校很少的偏遠地區，文盲比例仍然很高。)
The natural extrovert in the group immediately volunteered to present, while the quieter members prepared the final slides. (團體中天生外向的人立刻自願上台報告，較安靜的成員則準備最後的投影片。)
He attended science classes only sporadically, which made it really hard for teachers to assess his true progress. (他只有零星去上科學課，這讓老師很難真正評估他的實際進步。)

meaning: adj. 不精確的；不準確的
example: The witness gave an imprecise description, so the police could not identify the suspect. (目擊者的描述不精確，警方因此無法指認嫌犯。)
All the crockery was chipped, but the family meal was still lovely. (餐具都有缺口，但那頓家庭聚餐仍然很愉快。)

meaning: vt. 處理不當；錯誤處理
example: The hospital mishandled private patient records, and the mistake was only discovered later during an official internal inspection. (醫院處理病人隱私紀錄不當，這個錯誤直到後來一次官方稽查才被發現。)

meaning: vt. 驗證身分；鑑定真偽
example: Banks now use fingerprints to authenticate customers before allowing large transfers. (銀行現在使用指紋確認客戶身分，之後才允許大額轉帳。)
Delivery drivers rely on the postcode, but in rural areas it can sometimes cover several miles of road. (送貨司機依賴郵遞區號，但在鄉下，一個郵遞區號有時涵蓋好幾英里的道路。)

meaning: adj. 可達成的；可實現的
example: The government's housing target looks attainable only if construction speeds up sharply. (政府的住宅目標只有在建設加速時才看似可達成。)

meaning: v. 腐蝕；侵蝕；逐漸損害
example: Old underground pipes corrode faster in soft water, so the council plans to replace them throughout the district. (老舊地下管線在軟水中腐蝕得更快，因此市議會計畫全面更換這個地區的管線。)
The invitation was embossed with a pattern of small silver autumn leaves. (邀請卡上壓印著小銀色秋葉的圖案。)
High absenteeism during the winter flu season forced the school to combine several classes for almost two weeks. (冬季流感季期間曠課率偏高，迫使學校將幾個班級合併上課將近兩週。)
The new director hopes to reinvigorate the museum's struggling public education programme. (新館長希望為博物館陷入困境的公共教育計畫重新注入活力。)
The acrobatic birds swoop between narrow buildings, catching tiny insects in mid-air with astonishing speed and great precision. (這些雜技般的鳥在狹窄建築間俯衝，以驚人的速度和極高的精準度在空中捕捉小昆蟲。)

meaning:
n. 板條；木條
vt. 裝板條
example: One wooden slat on the bench was loose and pinched my leg. (長椅上一根木板條鬆了，夾到我的腿。)
Farmers hybridize different rice varieties to produce stronger and more productive plants. (農民讓不同稻作品種雜交，以培育更強壯、產量更高的植株。)

meaning: adj. 可塑的；易受影響的；有延展性的
example: Young children's minds are remarkably malleable, for better and for worse. (幼童的心智可塑性很高，可能帶來好處，也可能造成不利影響。)

meaning: n. 下水道系統；汙水處理
example: Heavy rain overwhelmed the aging sewerage system, and dirty water flooded several streets. (豪雨讓老舊的下水道系統不堪負荷，髒水淹了好幾條街。)
She felt dizziness after standing up too quickly and had to sit down. (她站起來太快感到頭昏眼花，只好坐下來。)
It is disrespectful to publicly mock someone's strong accent online, even when you clearly disagree with their opinion. (在網路上公開嘲笑別人濃重的口音很無禮，即使你明確不同意對方的觀點。)
The decrepit flat had no working heating, yet the landlord refused to repair anything properly before the winter. (這間破舊公寓沒有可用的暖氣，房東卻拒絕在冬天前好好修繕任何東西。)
Remember to lubricate the moving parts of the machine every few months. (記得每隔幾個月就為機器的活動零件上潤滑油。)
The typhoon destroyed most of the banana crop, so prices in the city rose sharply the following week. (颱風摧毀了大部分香蕉作物，因此城市裡的價格隔週大幅上漲。)
The market sells cheap colourful plastic trinkets, but few tourists really realise that most are actually made abroad. (這個市場賣廉價的彩色塑膠小飾品，但很少有遊客真正意識到大多數其實是國外製造。)
Phonetics helps learners understand how sounds are produced in the mouth and throat. (語音學幫助學習者了解聲音在口腔和喉嚨中如何產生。)
My aunt bought a kitchen gizmo that promised to save time, but she has used it only once. (我阿姨買了一個號稱能省時的廚房小裝置，但她只用過一次。)
The clerk took the manager's dictation and typed the whole letter afterwards. (職員記下經理口述的內容，之後把整封信打出來。)

meaning: adj. 適合居住的；可居住的
example: The planet lies in a habitable zone where liquid water could exist. (這顆行星位於適於居住的區域，那裡可能有液態水。)

meaning: n. 雜技演員；特技演員
example: The young acrobat performed above the crowd without a net, which clearly made several parents look away nervously. (年輕雜技演員在沒有安全網的情況下於觀眾上方表演，明顯讓幾位家長緊張地別過頭。)
My uncle is a workaholic who answers emails at midnight, yet he insists that he never feels tired. (我叔叔是個工作狂，半夜還在回電子郵件，卻堅稱自己從不覺得累。)
Rangers warn visitors not to light a campfire when the forest is this dry. (森林這麼乾燥時，巡守員警告遊客不要生營火。)
Farmers used chemicals to exterminate pests, but the method harmed other species. (農民用化學藥劑消滅害蟲，但這種方法也傷害了其他物種。)
The meal began with a small appetiser of grilled vegetables, olives and bread. (這頓飯以烤蔬菜、橄欖和麵包組成的小份開胃菜揭開序幕。)
The aggravation of his knee injury kept him off the team for months. (膝傷惡化，讓他好幾個月無法上場。)
Deflation can be harmful because consumers delay spending in the hope of lower prices. (通貨緊縮可能有害，因為消費者會期待價格下跌而延後消費。)

meaning: adj. 頑強的；不屈的；堅硬的
example: The team's unyielding defence frustrated opponents throughout the entire match, especially those who had expected an easy victory. (這支球隊頑強的防守讓對手整場比賽都很受挫，尤其是原本以為能輕鬆獲勝的隊伍。)
Healthy topsoil contains millions of unseen organisms, yet intensive farming can destroy it within just a few seasons. (健康的表層土含有數百萬看不見的生物，但密集耕作只要幾季就能摧毀它。)

meaning:
v. 按喇叭；鳴叫
n. 喇叭聲；雁鳴聲
example: Drivers honk their horns impatiently when the traffic lights take far too long. (紅綠燈等太久時，駕駛會不耐煩地按喇叭。)
The microbiology laboratory tests routine food samples, checking for harmful bacteria that could quickly cause very serious illness. (微生物實驗室檢驗常規食品樣本，檢查可能迅速造成非常嚴重疾病的有害細菌。)
A fire extinguisher must be checked every year and kept near the door. (滅火器每年都必須檢查，並放在門邊。)
Horticulture provides steady work for many families living in this fertile valley. (園藝為這座肥沃山谷的許多家庭提供穩定工作。)
She studied meteorology because she wanted to better understand storms, and now she warns fishing boats at sea. (她讀氣象學是因為想更了解暴風雨，現在她為海上的漁船發布警告。)
Feudalism gave landowners almost total power over the people who worked their fields. (封建制度讓地主對在他們田裡工作的人擁有幾乎絕對的權力。)
A kiwi contains more vitamin C than an orange of the same weight. (同樣重量下，奇異果的維生素C含量比柳橙高。)
The small charity discovered embezzlement last year, and the former treasurer has since repaid part of the money. (這家小型慈善機構去年發現盜用公款，前財務長此後已歸還部分款項。)
The small boat capsized in the strong wind, but everyone was rescued. (小船在強風中翻覆，但所有人都獲救。)
Keeping animals in tiny cages for their entire lives is widely considered inhumane. (把動物一輩子關在小籠子裡，普遍被認為不人道。)
The garden grows large subtropical plants, which survive here only because the winters stay unusually mild and short. (這座花園種著大型亞熱帶植物，它們能在這裡存活，只因為冬天異常溫和短暫。)
The report criticised factories that rely on exploitative labour to keep prices low. (報告批評那些靠剝削勞工來壓低價格的工廠。)

meaning: adj. 可通航的；可航行的
example: The canal is navigable for small boats, although many narrow low bridges force taller vessels to turn back. (這條運河可供小船通航，儘管許多低矮窄橋迫使較高的船隻折返。)
Very few taxpayers begrudge the money spent on hospitals and emergency services. (很少有納稅人對花在醫院和緊急服務上的錢感到不滿。)
A studious girl from the village won a scholarship to study medicine in Taipei. (村裡一位好學的女孩拿到獎學金，到台北讀醫學。)
Freedom of expression is regarded as an inalienable right in many democracies. (在許多民主國家，言論自由被視為不可剝奪的權利。)
Thrifty households often save money by repairing appliances instead of replacing them. (節儉的家庭常藉由修理家電而非汰換來省錢。)

meaning:
adj. 治療的；有療效的
n. 藥物；療法
example: The plant was once thought to have strong curative properties, but careful trials later found no clear reliable effect. (這種植物曾被認為具有強烈療效，但後來的嚴謹試驗並未發現明確可靠的效果。)
Advertisers are accused of using subliminal images to make viewers want products they do not need. (廣告商被指控用潛意識影像，讓觀眾想買他們其實不需要的產品。)
A normal whisper is usually about thirty decibels, which is why public libraries feel calm and restful. (一般耳語的音量約為三十分貝，這也是公共圖書館讓人感到平靜安適的原因。)

meaning: adj. 兩棲的；水陸兩用的
example: The frog is amphibious, moving between the pond and the open meadow. (這隻青蛙是兩棲動物，會在池塘和開闊草地之間移動。)

meaning: vt. 使迷失方向；使困惑
example: The twisting streets of the old town disorientate most first-time visitors completely. (老城區蜿蜒的街道讓大多數初次造訪的旅客完全迷失方向。)
Divers must ascend slowly and stop for decompression to avoid harmful bubbles in the blood. (潛水員必須慢慢上升，並停下來減壓，以免血液中形成有害氣泡。)

meaning:
n. 一百週年；百年紀念
adj. 百年的；百年紀念的
example: The town held a parade to mark the centennial of its founding. (這座小鎮舉行遊行，紀念建鎮一百週年。)
It is hard to decouple tourism from environmental damage completely, since visitors inevitably consume large amounts of water and fuel. (很難讓觀光與環境破壞完全脫鉤，因為遊客無可避免會消耗大量水和燃料。)
Growing disenchantment with city life led them to move to the coast. (對城市生活日益失望，讓他們決定搬到海邊。)

meaning: adj. 漠不關心的；冷淡的
example: Many young voters seem apathetic about local elections and do not bother to vote. (許多年輕選民對地方選舉顯得漠不關心，也懶得去投票。)
The incongruity of a luxury car outside the food bank was striking. (食品銀行外停著一輛豪華轎車，這種不協調格外醒目。)
Hold the handrail when you go down the steps, especially when they are wet. (下階梯時請扶著扶手，尤其是階梯溼滑的時候。)
The beekeeper carefully moved the old wooden beehive, protecting the queen and keeping the colony calm. (養蜂人小心移動舊木蜂箱，保護蜂王並讓蜂群保持平靜。)
The city incinerates most of its household waste and uses the heat to generate electricity. (這座城市焚化大部分家庭垃圾，並利用熱能發電。)
She trained in hairdressing for two years before opening her own salon. (她受了兩年的美髮訓練，之後才開了自己的髮廊。)

meaning: vt. 使顯得不重要；輕忽
example: Newspapers sometimes trivialize serious social problems by focusing only on shocking personal details. (報紙有時藉由聚焦聳動細節，使嚴重的社會問題顯得不重要。)
Luxuriant vegetation covers the hillsides after the first heavy rains of summer. (夏季第一場大雨過後，繁茂的植被覆蓋山坡。)

meaning: adj. 別有用心的；隱藏的
example: He offered to help, but I suspected he had an ulterior motive. (他主動要幫忙，但我懷疑他有不可告人的動機。)
A short siesta after lunch improves afternoon concentration, according to a study of office workers in southern Europe. (根據一項針對南歐上班族的研究，午餐後短暫午睡能提升下午的專注力。)
Refraction of light through water makes objects appear closer than they are. (光在水中折射，會讓物體看起來比實際更近。)

meaning: adj. 有感覺能力的；有知覺的
example: Some philosophers argue that all sentient beings deserve a degree of moral consideration. (有些哲學家主張，所有有感覺能力的生物都應受到某種程度的道德考量。)
The firm prefabricates entire bathroom units in a factory before delivering them to site. (這家公司先在工廠預製整個衛浴單元，再運到工地。)
Bees pollinate a large share of the crops that feed people around the world. (蜜蜂為世界上餵養人類的大部分農作物授粉。)
A zoologist explained how the reserve helps protect endangered species from poaching. (一位動物學家說明保護區如何協助保護瀕危物種免於盜獵。)
Despite the infirmities of old age, she still walks to the market daily. (儘管年老體弱，她仍每天走到市場。)

meaning: adj. 密封的；氣密的；無懈可擊的
example: The biscuits stayed fresh for weeks because they were kept in a large airtight jar. (餅乾放在密封罐裡保存，因此幾週後仍然新鮮。)
Her snobbish attitude towards cheaper brands made her unpopular among many colleagues. (她對較便宜品牌的勢利態度，讓她在同事之間不受歡迎。)
Extracurricular sports keep teenagers active, but they can also easily crowd out all homework on busy weekday evenings. (課外運動讓青少年保持活躍，但也可能輕易佔掉忙碌平日晚上所有的功課時間。)
The old horse's sinews were stiff, so the vet advised gentle daily exercise rather than standing still all day. (老馬的肌腱僵硬，因此獸醫建議每天溫和運動，而不是整天站著不動。)
The optometrist found that his left eye had become slightly worse again. (驗光師發現他的左眼度數又稍微變差了。)
A cataclysmic earthquake changed the course of the river in a single night. (一場災難性的地震在一夜之間改變了河道。)

meaning: adj. 柔韌的；易彎曲的；順從的
example: Young willow branches are pliable enough to bend without breaking, which is why gardeners shape them carefully each spring. (年輕柳枝夠柔軟，可以彎曲而不折斷，因此園丁每年春天都小心地為它們塑形。)
Cutting funding for maintenance could imperil the safety of the railway network. (削減維修經費可能危及鐵路網的安全。)
Recent advances in optics have made cameras smaller without reducing image quality. (光學近來的進步讓相機變得更小，影像品質卻沒有下降。)
The old breakwater was badly damaged last winter, leaving the harbour exposed to strong easterly winds. (舊防波堤去年冬天嚴重受損，使港口暴露在強勁的東風中。)

meaning: n. 複習課程；進修課程
example: Older drivers must take a short refresher course after a certain age, though many resent the extra cost. (年長駕駛到一定年齡後必須參加短期複習課程，不過許多人對額外費用很不滿。)
Pure water freezes at zero degrees centigrade, which is thirty-two degrees Fahrenheit. (純水在攝氏零度結冰，也就是華氏三十二度。)
Farmers who overgraze their fields soon find that the soil cannot recover. (過度放牧的農民很快就會發現土壤無法恢復。)
People who procrastinate often produce weaker work than those who plan their time carefully. (習慣拖延的人，成果往往比仔細規劃時間的人差。)
The hotel's opulence contrasts sharply with the poverty of the surrounding neighbourhood. (飯店的富麗與周圍社區的貧困形成強烈對比。)

meaning: adj. 站得住腳的；可維持的
example: Their business plan is no longer tenable now that online rivals offer exactly the same service far cheaper. (如今線上競爭對手以更便宜的價格提供完全相同的服務，他們的商業計畫已經站不住腳。)

meaning: adj. 不可信的；不可靠的

meaning: adj. 可惡的；令人憎惡的

meaning: vt. 重新定位；重新調整方向
example: After the injury, she reoriented her career towards coaching and soon found full-time work at a local club. (受傷之後，她把職涯重新定位到教練工作，很快就在當地俱樂部找到全職工作。)
Some critics argue that advertising tends to objectify women by reducing them to appearances. (有些批評者認為，廣告往往把女性物化，只把她們簡化為外表。)

meaning: adj. 毫不掩飾的；公開的
example: Her undisguised relief was obvious when the exam results were finally published online that morning. (考試成績終於在那天早上公布上網時，她毫不掩飾地流露出寬慰。)
Colleagues gathered to commiserate with her after her job application was rejected. (她的申請被拒後，同事們聚在一起安慰她。)
The novel portrays the landowner as indolent and indifferent to his tenants. (這本小說把地主描寫成懶惰又對佃農漠不關心的人。)

meaning: adj. 不可侵犯的；神聖的
example: The constitution declares that personal privacy is an inviolable right for every citizen. (憲法宣告個人隱私是每位公民不可侵犯的權利。)

meaning: adj. 突兀的；過分顯眼的

meaning:
adj. 男女同校的

The bridge uses cables with high tensile strength to support the deck. (這座橋使用高抗拉強度的纜索支撐橋面。)

Careful refrigeration slows spoilage in milk, yet long power cuts during sudden storms still cause serious losses. (妥善冷藏能減緩牛奶變質，但突發暴風雨造成的長時間停電仍會帶來嚴重損失。)

meaning: n. 電影攝影；攝影技術

University students who plagiarise the work of others face serious academic penalties. (抄襲他人作品的學生會面臨嚴重的學術懲處。)

The island's insularity has helped preserve its language but limited economic opportunities. (這座島的與世隔絕保存了語言，卻限制了經濟機會。)

meaning: adj. 令人沮喪的；令人洩氣的
example: The dispiriting news arrived early on Monday, when the factory confirmed that two hundred local jobs would go. (令人沮喪的消息在週一清晨傳來，工廠確認將裁掉兩百個當地工作。)
The recent zoological survey recorded fewer frogs than expected, suggesting that the wetland is already drying out rapidly. (最近的動物學調查記錄到的青蛙比預期少，顯示這片濕地正快速乾涸。)

meaning: adj. 可退款的；可退還的
example: The ticket is refundable only if the concert is cancelled, so always check the terms carefully before booking. (這張票只有在演唱會取消時才可退款，因此訂票前一定要仔細查看條款。)

meaning: adv. 禁不住地；強迫性地
example: He gambled compulsively for years, accumulating large debts that eventually forced his family to sell their own house. (他多年禁不住地賭博，累積龐大債務，最終迫使家人賣掉自己的房子。)
Farmers often deforest land to grow crops, unaware of the long-term damage. (農民常砍伐森林以種植作物，卻未意識到長期的損害。)

meaning:
adj. 攝氏的
n. 攝氏

meaning: n. 象形文字；圖畫文字

meaning: n. 市鎮風貌；城市景觀
example: According to a local campaign group, the new flats would ruin the historic townscape. (當地一個倡議團體表示，新公寓將破壞歷史悠久的市鎮風貌。)
It is discourteous to answer a phone call while having dinner with guests. (和客人吃晚餐時接電話是很無禮的。)
The aridity of the region makes farming possible only near the river. (這個地區的乾旱使得只能在河邊務農。)

meaning: adv. 明顯地；實際可感地
example: Local air quality has improved tangibly since the factory installed new filters, and asthma cases have fallen steadily. (自從工廠裝了新濾網後，當地空氣品質有明顯可感受的改善，氣喘病例也穩定下降。)
Our host was so easy-going that he let us change our travel plans three times without ever complaining. (我們的主人非常隨和，讓我們三度更改旅遊計畫也毫無怨言。)

meaning: adj. 鼓舞人心的；激勵人的
example: The teacher's inspiring lessons persuaded several shy students to study engineering at university despite the difficult entrance exams. (這位老師鼓舞人心的課程，說服了幾位害羞的學生不畏困難的入學考試，攻讀大學工程系。)
The crowded night market perhaps epitomises the energy of the city, attracting both locals and curious foreign visitors. (擁擠的夜市或許最能體現這座城市的活力，同時吸引本地人和好奇的外國遊客。)
A strange odour in the corridor led the manager to call in a gas technician. (走廊上有一股奇怪的氣味，讓經理請來瓦斯技師檢查。)
Children learn faster when their surroundings are colourful and tidy, according to a recent study of primary classrooms. (根據一項針對小學教室的近期研究，環境色彩豐富又整潔時，孩子學得更快。)

meaning: adj. 引人注目的；顯著的
example: The most striking feature of the village is its wall of coloured tiles. (這個村落最引人注目的特色，就是那面彩磚牆。)

meaning:
n. 努力；嘗試
vi. 努力；試圖

meaning: adj. 蓬勃發展的；繁榮的

Diesel fumes from the daily school buses have raised serious concerns among nearby parents about children's lung health. (每天接送學生的巴士排放柴油廢氣，讓附近家長嚴重關切孩子的肺部健康。)

meaning: adj. 可延伸的；可延長的

meaning: adj. 精密的；複雜的；老練的

She teaches aerobics at the community centre on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. (她每週二、週四晚上在活動中心教有氧運動。)

meaning: adj. 先進的；高級的；進階的

meaning: adj. 重疊的；部分相同的

meaning: adj. 有眼光的；有鑑賞力的

meaning: adj. 根本的；潛在的；在下面的

meaning: n. 商品陳列；商品規劃；周邊商品

meaning: adj. 最新的；跟上時代的

meaning: adj. 會枯竭的；可耗盡的

meaning:

meaning: adj. 毀滅性的；極具破壞力的；令人震驚的
example: The wildfire had a devastating impact on local wildlife, and experts believe full recovery will take several decades. (這場野火對當地野生動物造成毀滅性影響，專家認為完全復原需要數十年。)

meaning: n. 註冊；入學；註冊人數

meaning: adj. 不自然的；做作的；人為的

meaning:
n. 理解；諒解；共識
adj. 體諒的；善解人意的

The large-scale evacuation began at dawn as floodwater moved towards several low-lying villages. (洪水朝幾個低窪村莊逼近，大規模撤離行動於黎明開始。)

meaning:
n. 癒合；治療

meaning:
adj. 高科技的

example: The city hopes to attract major high-tech industry, offering generous tax breaks and new research facilities nearby. (這座城市希望吸引大型高科技產業，並提供優渥的稅務減免和附近的研究設施。)

meaning: adj. 長時間的；持續很久的

meaning: adj. 慘重的；令人崩潰的
